entities.src: sections.md: two four-mule wagons swinging round the corner (≈ 3200–3850)
entities.note: SCALE CUES: the near wheel is a tall ellipse u 3750-3800, v 333-507 (about 48 px wide, 170 px tall; the vertical extent is about its diameter, the narrow width means its plane recedes steeply); hub about (3776, 423). RECEDING: front panel's top edge (3583, 380)->(3693, 320), slope -0.55; rear panel's top edge (3717, 390)->(3813, 310), slope -0.83; shafts and traces (3720, 477)->(3540, 547), slope -0.39 (the wagon's axis, turning, not the frame's depth direction).
